title: GreenGateway policy analysis suppression request
description: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for the body of POST /v1{ADMIN_PREFIX}/policy/analyses/suppressions: one analyzer finding, named by the fingerprint and code a policy-analysis-results.v1 report gave it, the resource snapshot digest that report carried, an expiry and a reason. The request names the live policy ETag in If-Match. The gateway's checks are authoritative and also enforce what JSON Schema cannot state here: the reason's bound in bytes (not characters) and that it is not only whitespace, unique member names, and that expires_at is after now and at most 90 days after it on the store's clock. Unknown members are refused: there is no member that suppresses more than one finding.
